description: A sequence tree has uncountably many paths exactly when it has a nonempty perfect subtree.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PerfectSubtrees.uncountable_iff_perfect_subtree {T : Set (List ℕ)}
  (hT : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PerfectSubtrees.IsSequenceTree T) :
  ¬(Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PerfectSubtrees.body T).Countable ↔
    ∃ P,
      Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PerfectSubtrees.IsSubtree P T ∧ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PerfectSubtrees.IsPerfect P ∧ P.Nonempty
